reviews.text: Very good service and excellent professionalism from Dr. Alejandro
Top-notch professionals
We are delighted with this center, we take all our pets there and they have always treated us wonderfully.
My dog ​​has been going there since he was a puppy, and the care for Pitufo is unbeatable.
I love how they treat my pet, my cat Cobi is in the best hands
I took my dog ​​Neska and they were wonderful. I'll definitely be back.
I always take my pet there and the service is excellent. Great professionals.
Exceptional service. Very professional and attentive.

I can only express my gratitude. The pain we feel after Thorin's death is indescribable, but knowing that Diego did everything possible to ensure my little one had the best life possible for the time he had left, and the empathy shown by the rest of the team, has demonstrated how much this veterinary clinic helped us, even when we decided to do what seemed so difficult. But my little Thorin, from across the rainbow bridge, thanks you for the love, professionalism, and gentleness you showed him. THANK YOU for trying everything, even though the miracle we hoped for wasn't possible. Trying with all your strength and resources means the world to us. Unfortunately, our little one had something too severe for him to survive, but you were all there to make his end as painless as possible. It pains me to say that we won't see you again, because after how devastated we are by the loss of my little one, I don't think we'll have any more pets. But if that ever happens, I don't want any other veterinary clinic but Vicalcan and Diego helping us. Thank you for everything, Vicalcan.

A very good experience. I contacted them and was quickly able to schedule an appointment and run tests on my cat to rule out any problems.
The explanations were direct and clear, and they found solutions to any problems or difficulties that arose. Isabel, the veterinarian who saw us, was very gentle with my cat and clearly explained all the possible courses of action.
I'm glad to have a local veterinarian I can trust.
Thank you very much.

A few days ago, we had to put our dog, Jump, to sleep after 12 years. I can only say that the care we received from them, from beginning to end—in checkups, consultations, treatments, in health and in sickness—was wonderful.

Not only was their treatment professional, but their knowledge, their warmth, their humanity, and the love they showed to both people and animals were also outstanding. We brought both Jump and our previous dog, Blacky, to Vicalcán (we've known them for about 25 years now), and we can't thank them enough for everything they did. They gave us complete confidence in everything they told us, advised us, and suggested.

I wholeheartedly recommend this center for the care of our pets. Thank you so much for everything, to absolutely all of your staff.

We are very unhappy with the service we've received. For weeks now, we've noticed a significant change. The receptionist who's usually there is quite unfriendly, to the point that it seems like she's bothered by anyone who comes in. In fact, while we were waiting to pay, she had a couple knocking on the door for nearly 10 minutes while she was inside chatting with her colleagues, and when she came out, her face said it all. (She should consider finding another job that motivates her more than this one.) We had to call because the day before, we went to get our little ones vaccinated, and we thought one of them had an infection. They told us to bring a sample the next day. Since she was urinating very little, we called to see if that would be enough. They said they would check, but hours passed, and no one called us back. We called three times to see if they had reported it. Finally, at 7 pm, we called again, and they told us they had passed on the notification at 2 pm and didn't know why they hadn't contacted us. Furthermore, the girl who answered the phone gave us excuses that made absolutely no sense, and when we tried to answer them directly, she just stayed silent.

I hope this reaches someone and they take a look at the kind of staff they have in charge.
Animals are not objects; they are little people who are part of our family, and they should be cared for more instead of being seen as numbers.

They are incredibly unprofessional and unhelpful; the staff is very unfriendly. We had to call three times to get a response to a problem we had, and we didn't receive any reply from any veterinarian. Very disappointing.
The assistants aren't as friendly as you might expect when you arrive at a place like this, however, the veterinarians show passion and dedication for what they do
Thank you, Himilce. We are pleased to know that you were satisfied with the care and treatment at Centro Veterinario Vicalcán - Vicálvaro, in Madrid, Vicálvaro.

They are our trusted vet, and I can only say good things about them. We've had several emergencies with our dogs, and as a result, several of their vets have treated us. They've always been incredibly attentive to my dogs, listening carefully and paying attention to everything, finding the best solution, and being extremely attentive to their recoveries. I'm delighted with them and recommend them 100%. Thank you for being who you are.
My go-to vet. My puppy doesn't know any other place and he's already 12 years old. Thank you team for always taking such good care of him and loving him so much.
Thank you so much, Jorge, for trusting Centro Veterinario Vicalcán - Vicálvaro, in Madrid, Vicálvaro. Best regards!
Thank you, Miguel. We're glad to hear that you were pleased with the service and attention you received.
Thank you so much, Sergio, for trusting our team at Centro Veterinario Vicalcán - Vicálvaro. We'll always be here for you whenever you need us.
Thank you so much, Javier, for your time. We're glad to hear you're happy with our service. We'll always be here for you whenever you need us. Best regards.
In my experience, the treatment of our furry friends at this veterinarian is impeccable.

I called during opening hours to ask if I could bring my dog ​​in, who had hurt his leg, and they told me that if I came in now they would have to charge me 105 euros as an emergency. It's more like a bank than a clinic; it's a disgrace.

I was there yesterday with my greyhound, Blanca, for a heart condition, and both the cardiologist and the staff who attended to us were incredibly understanding, warm, and helpful. They explained everything in detail, even with drawings. Without a doubt, a fantastic team!

Thank you so much for the care you gave my greyhound, whom they described as a retired athlete, Blanca, and for the way you treated us!

Highly, highly recommended!
A wonderful example of honesty from the vet today with my dog ​​and my son. Thank you so much for your attention, I loved the thoughtful gesture. You're trustworthy ❤️
Thank you so much for your review, Miguel!

They were my teachers years ago, and I've trusted them ever since. They're great professionals: Carolina, who is also incredibly kind; Alejandro, who is attentive and friendly; Laura—in short, they're specialists, and it shows.

Thank you so much, already for Sugus, Rumba, and now Canela :)

I'm very happy with the treatment and professionalism, particularly with Dr. Marta, the ophthalmologist. She treats our cat Canela at the Parla clinic and also in Vicálvaro for viral conjunctivitis due to stress. To avoid further anxiety for Canela, she handled my appointments over the phone with great skill and empathy. I'm very grateful.
The in-person appointments were also fantastic. She knows how to treat cats with difficult temperaments, like mine, with great patience, calm, and affection.
In short: excellent! Thank you!
Our experience has always been positive, both in terms of facilities, reasonable waiting times, and professional service.

Two years after Boss's death, I'm finally writing this review after talking to neighbors and reading other reviews from people who had a bad experience.
My 11-year-old dog had his gallbladder removed. The operation supposedly went well, but he died two days later. They couldn't give me a clear explanation of what happened. I will NEVER forgive you for letting my life companion die alone. We asked twice if he was going to die, and you told us no, that he just needed to stay overnight. You called me to tell me to bring down some canned food for lunch at midday, and he looked very ill, but I wasn't sure if I was exaggerating. His tongue was completely blue, but I trusted that he wasn't going to die, since that's what you told me, and I trusted your judgment, because you're the "professionals."

My mother called again in the afternoon to see if he was going to die, and they told her, "No, woman, don't say that." Three hours later, they called us and told us that Boss had passed away.
Every January 19th, I remember you with the deepest hatred a person can feel. I don't care about the money you squeezed out of me, but letting him die alone is unforgivable.
I'm leaving you his photos so you don't forget his face. You carry this death on your conscience, and you made me live through a nightmare. You got away with not doing an autopsy because I wanted him to rest in peace and have his ashes as soon as possible.
I neither forgive you nor forget you!
